label: P1 SV
notes: The Upgrades tab uses this set (P1_SV_EP_PRESET) for a hunter whose Survival tree has strictly more talent points than each other tree; every other hunter gets P1_BM_EP_PRESET.
At this pin P1_SV_EP_PRESET has the same numbers as P1_BM_EP_PRESET; it is kept as its own set so that each follows upstream if the two ever differ.
